note: The predicate, worker, resource-group and node-type names the valid corpus resolves against. FD-V4, FD-V5, FD-V31 and FD-V32 are refusals ABOUT a registry, so their cases name entries this file deliberately omits. A node type's pool is keyed by its name, so every nodeTypes entry is a workerTypes entry too (FD-V32); the type's validator is a function and lives beside the predicates' in test/definition/corpus-types.ts, registered under the name here.
